long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Unknown seeds that grow without permission still bother me, and I want to know more than I have been told.
I will draw the moon in the colour I am still unsure of, and keep it where I can see it.
The lookout rock is mine, and a picture on record makes the claim stick.
Thinking is tiring, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover.
From a high place I can see everything that has not yet been claimed by me.

today.reason: The stash step cannot work with empty paws and the clay is already shaped, so I am dropping it and keeping to the reading, drawing, photographing, napping and watching.
